title: Murkglider Breeder
summary: The Murkglider Breeder continually replenishes its spawn during combat.
overview: The Murkglider Breeder continually replenishes its spawn during combat.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: Collect the first murkglider as the breeder is engaged.
Further spawn checks occur every twenty seconds while the breeder fights.
Keep the adds under control while maintaining damage on the breeder.
